newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bakrie sees British Steel partnership.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie sees British Steel partnership.

text.p: The head of Indonesian holding company PT Bakrie & Brothers said on Wednesday Bakrie was still finalising a $800 million steel plant project likely to involve British Steel Plc in Lampung, south Sumatra.

"A joint venture with British Steel is likely (to happen). Discussions to sharpen the plan are still underway," Bakrie President Tanri Abeng told reporters after chairing the company's annual general meeting.
"When it comes to a partnership between Bakrie and British Steel, such a thing is most likely," said Abeng, adding that a decision on the venture could be made in September.
Bakrie said last month the company was holding talks with possible partners, including British Steel, to build a steel plant in Lampung province in the southernmost tip of Sumatra island.
Abeng said Bakrie had found a location in Lampung for the plant, while British Steel still needed assurance about, among other things, electricity.
